title: Building my MMO Veldeth with Claude Code: bosses, skills, mounts and gliding
author: Outside_Raise5722
selftext:
Solo dev, building an MMO called Veldeth in my own C++ engine. Claude Code does a big chunk of the work with me:



\- Blender pipeline: Claude drives Blender over MCP to rig and animate creatures (one of the bosses' walk/attack/death clips were made entirely by Claude), export models, place props and build roads

\- Game systems: skills + VFX, the glider (Jolt physics rays), mounts, weather, dungeon portals, boss fights

\- Server side: quests, dailies, trading post, all patched on a test server first



I do the art direction, playtesting and the hand-tuning; Claude writes most of the code and tooling. Happy to answer questions about the workflow.
